verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents an official `vastai` agent skill that lets AI coding assistants drive the platform on the user's behalf: creating instances, deploying endpoints, managing SSH keys and checking balances. An llms.txt file and an OpenAPI spec support agent use, so users can in effect operate Vast.ai through natural language. However, this depends on an external AI assistant rather than a built-in natural-language interface, and only vendor docs describe it. Missing for 10: native first-party natural-language console or command interface, depth on what operations the skill covers and how reliable it is, independent or hands-on corroboration.
